experiment: CPU-only generative answer extraction from complete SQuAD passages

dataset.dataset: SQuAD v1.1 short-passage, short-answer extraction subset
dataset.citation: Rajpurkar, Zhang, Lopyrev, Liang (2016). SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text. arXiv:1606.05250.
dataset.policy: Complete passages only, no cropping/truncation. Keep only declared context/prompt limits and questions whose every reference answer fits the target-token limit. First reference is training target; all references score generation. Article-disjoint splits, one question per passage, deterministic round-robin sampling across articles. Official dev is the local held-out test; this is not the official hidden SQuAD test or a full-dataset leaderboard score.

selection.criterion: minimum validation response-token loss, including initial model

optimizations.generation: left-padded greedy batches, length sorted, restored source order; per-row EOS trimming

limitations: This is a filtered short-passage/short-answer subset, not the full SQuAD benchmark or its hidden test set.
The historical Wikipedia/SQuAD material may have appeared in the base model's pretraining.
Every question is answerable; abstention, unanswerable questions, long documents and OCR are not evaluated.
Article and exact-passage separation cannot exclude all related facts or near-duplicate material.
Loss selects checkpoints; improved loss does not guarantee improved generated exact match or F1.
Batched generation may have small floating-point differences from serial generation; max token caps can truncate answers.
Only IDs, hashes and scores are published by default; raw passages, references and generated answers remain in local artifacts.
No end-to-end speedup claim is made without a matched document-task baseline run; transferred optimizations are disclosed.
